items.title: Onboarding
items.name: onboarding
items.prompt: You are generating the Onboarding section for an Ansible configuration management and LLM Ops deployment repository. This section must include a Principal-Level Guide focusing on the core architectural insight (Ansible playbooks orchestrating monolithic roles, with an integrated LLM analyzer callback capturing execution traces), and a Zero-to-Hero Learning Path for newcomers covering YAML/Ansible foundations, the specific role taxonomy, and dev setup. Cite file_path:line_number for core plays like playbooks/site.yml:1.

children.title: Principal-Level Guide
children.name: principal_level_guide
children.prompt: Create a dense, opinionated guide for senior ICs. The ONE core architectural insight is that configuration management is strictly enforced (idempotency, variable scoping) while acting as a testbed for agentic coding workflows via the `llm_analyzer` callback plugin. Include a Mermaid system architecture diagram showing the relationship between playbooks, roles, inventory, and the LLM trace store. Show pseudocode in Python of how an agent interacts with this IaC pattern. Reference playbooks/site.yml:1 and plugins/callback/llm_analyzer.py:1.

children.title: Zero to Hero Learning Path
children.name: zero_to_hero
children.prompt: Create a progressive learning path for newcomers. Part I: Ansible and YAML foundations with cross-language comparisons (e.g., Ansible YAML vs Python dicts/lists). Part II: This codebase's architecture and domain model (site.yml, system layer, user layer, osbuild, llmops). Part III: Dev setup using bin/setup:1, testing, and contributing. Include a glossary of terms like 'Idempotency', 'LLM Analyzer', 'OSBuild'.

items.title: Getting Started
items.name: getting_started
items.prompt: Generate the Getting Started guides for provisioning a workstation using this repository.

children.title: Overview
children.name: overview
children.prompt: Provide a high-level overview of the workstation provisioning capabilities, including desktop environments, virtualization, container runtimes, and local LLM ops stack. Reference README.md:1.

children.title: Bootstrap Setup
children.name: bootstrap_setup
children.prompt: Detail the bootstrap procedure using the TUI orchestrator script at bin/setup:1. Explain the prerequisites, GPG key check, and YADM integration.

children.title: Playbook Execution
children.name: playbook_execution
children.prompt: Explain how to execute playbooks manually, focusing on the master orchestrator playbooks/site.yml:1 and tag-based limited scope runs.

items.title: Deep Dive
items.name: deep_dive
items.prompt: Explore the architecture, subsystems, and components of the repository.

children.title: Architecture & Design
children.name: architecture
children.prompt: Detail the configuration management discipline, the variable tiering strategy defined in docs/variable-precedence.md:1, and the transition to a monolithic repository structure.

children.title: LLM Analyzer System
children.name: llm_analyzer_system
children.prompt: Deep dive into the custom LLM analyzer callback plugin at plugins/callback/llm_analyzer.py:1, the async worker pool design, and the DSPy trainset generation scripts/llm_trainset.py:1.

children.title: Ansible Roles & Playbooks
children.name: roles_playbooks
children.prompt: Document the core subsystems: the Base System Role (roles/base/tasks/main.yml:1), Container Orchestration (roles/containerd/tasks/main.yml:1), OSBuild Image Building (playbooks/osbuild.yml:1), and the LLMOps Deployment Stack (dify, langfuse, ollama, hermes, tts).
